content:
emily: FYI AcuityLabs (acct ACU-314) flagged INV-2026-330. Looks like reserved capacity was billed to a partner master (VendorX) and also billed to the customer as overage. Double-bill situation. Can finance triage?
raj: Uh oh. Do we have the reseller routing id on the invoice? If VendorX has a master purchase order it should have been single-billed to them, not ACU.
billing-bot: Invoice INV-2026-330 lines:
```
Line#1: RSRV-L-2026 (billed to VendorX-MASTER-77), qty 1, period 2026-07-01 - 2026-07-31, amt $11,000
Line#2: OVG-TOK, 250,000 tokens, amt $1,375 (billed to ACU-314)
Total $12,375
```
tom: Sales: We sold Acuity via VendorX reseller program. VendorX submitted a PO for the reserved L; they should be on the invoice. It looks like provisioning attached vendor tag but billing engine still created a separate overage line under the end-customer.
laura: Partner-ops: VendorX PO# VX-2026-550 exists and payment was applied to our partner ledger. Their contract states we bill them for reserved commit and the customer pays only usage (if any). So this overage line to ACU is incorrect.
emily: Metering snapshot (Jul 01-31) for ACU-314:
```
2026-07-01,committed_units,burst_units
2026-07-05,800000,180000
2026-07-12,800000,40000
TOTAL,800000,220000
```
amanda: Customer note: "We were charged $1,375 for overage tokens on top of partner bill. Please remove; we pay via VendorX."
raj: Quick calc: overage 220k tokens but vendor agreement says VendorX covers up to 300k burst for migration in July. So overage $1,375 should be credited and vendor billed instead.
finance_director: Approve credit up to $5k per partner reconciliation policy without exec sign. Prepare CM and move AR entries to vendor invoicing. 
emily: Drafted credit memo CM-2026-031 for $1,375, reason: "Reseller routing misallocation: overage billed to end-customer; vendor liable per PO VX-2026-550." Posting to AR and marking invoice INV-2026-330 as reissued INV-2026-330-R1 with credit line.
laura: Also need to adjust our partner ledger: create vendor charge VN-2026-550-RC for $1,375 and attach PO. I'll coordinate collections with partner team.
billing-bot: AR adjusted: CM-2026-031 created, AR-TX-33421 posted. INV-2026-330-R1 total $11,000 (overage removed). Original marked superseded.
amanda: I sent a note to Acuity: "Thanks, we corrected your invoice and issued a credit. The reserved commit remains billed to VendorX per the reseller agreement." They replied "Thanks for the quick fix." :thumbsup:
raj: Log as BILL-2026-402 with attachments: invoice, CM, PO, metering. Closing once partner acknowledgement.
laura: VendorX acknowledged liability and confirmed they will remit via PO VX-2026-550. Marking partner ledger updated.
emily: Closing thread. Thanks team.
